svg.title: Several color modes can coexist in one category
svg.desc: Several color modes can coexist in one category. The study includes 1119 distinct files from 1099 source posts. Each mode shows six swatches with widths proportional to measured pixel assignments, its file count within the category, and exact September 27 median likes with a separate post count. Sparse like observations do not support causal comparisons.
